Selling to the EU? GPSR is only half the story. The EU Packaging EPR + PPWR rules can block your listings and fine you up to EUR 200k.

The EU Packaging EPR Action Kit covers:
- EPR registration per member state
- PPWR 2026 requirements
- Packaging declarations + labels
- Take-back scheme navigation
